purpose: Describe doing something in one sustained burst.
keywords: I finished the short novel in one sitting.
I ran up the stairs in one burst.
The temperature dropped ten degrees in one go.
restrictions: Emphasizes momentum or completion without substantial interruption.
mistake: This is not simply a synonym for suddenly.
